notes: OAI-PMH datestamps are last-modification times and cannot select papers by submission date; they are not used for era candidate enumeration.
The arXiv API submittedDate query enumerates candidates; exact arXivRaw GetRecord calls resolve version history and item license for selected IDs.
Category eligibility remains provisional until metadata volume and bounded manual exposure review pass.
Cross-listed computing, economics, mathematics, quantitative-finance, statistics, and social-physics records are excluded to reduce direct procedural and decision-task exposure.
Titles and abstracts are hashed and counted but not retained in metadata output.
Source C remains under the held-out-source firewall.
